elements.description: Those who fall within the Bounds find their bodies overtaken by a notorious fungus, becoming mere zombies driven by base instinct, staggering forward. Filled with mycelia, they lack organs or weak points, making them exceptionally difficult to kill.

elements.description: The faintest trace of pain and hatred from the Wolf‑Divided—or one of Its Name—yet so intense it makes the air seethe; if I try to deny its presence, something will surely be destroyed.

elements.label: ‘Major Morozova’
elements.description: A disciple of the Scarred Captain, a Soviet officer, foe of my sharp-tongued rebel ally. I have no wish to entangle myself in the web of an Edge dyad, yet Isolde will pay the price for her reckless mockery of a Name. Perhaps this is exactly what she intended all along.

elements.label: A Remnant of Morozova?
elements.description: Snow-pale, stained with the blood-red light of the god which is not as it was. It will soon fade like melting snow.
